description: Structured return envelope for delegated agent work in the CP8 INF8 evolution loop. Frozen source: CP8_PARALLEL_AGENT_HANDOFF_2026-08-17.md (SHA-256 3ffb47b3ebfbd8cade9c60437d6828aaa63ce8da1f319b74df1f2c4a7ac28b9e), RETURN ENVELOPE sections of Payload A (Kimi) and Payload B (Grok), identical except for the observed[].timestamp_class enum noted below. Receipt: CP8_PARALLEL_AGENT_HANDOFF_RECEIPT_2026-08-17.json (return_schema: CP8-AGENT-RETURN-v1).

agent.description: Returning seat/agent name, e.g. Kimi, Grok, GrokAce, a subagent id, or a browser task id. (Source shows plain strings with no length constraint; none added.)

contradictions.description: Conflicts preserved, never resolved by agent majority vote (coordinator intake rule 3). Each entry records which side carries the stronger evidence and why.

generated_at_utc.description: UTC generation timestamp of the return.

observed.description: Observed claims only: what was actually seen, with source, method, and the timestamp class of the date basis (source rule: reconcile T0 message timestamp, T1 embedded event date, T2 clean thread-start event, T3 thread-header only, T4 file creation time before origin claims; NA where no timestamp applies).

timestamp_class.description: Union of the two source payloads: Payload A (Kimi) allows T0|T1|T2|T3|T4|NA; Payload B (Grok) fixes NA. Both are encoded here; the lane determines which values are appropriate.

promotion.description: Promotion gate state as declared by the returning agent. A self-declared level does not independently earn that level (receipt forward_test rejected exactly that); the coordinator earns or holds it at intake.

recommended_next_action.description: The single smallest reversible next action (source C4 checkpoints).

git_commit.description: Frozen source commit the work was performed against.

task_id.description: The delegated task identifier exactly as assigned, e.g. CP8-INF8-KIMI-OAI-FORENSICS-2026-08-17. (Source shows plain strings with no length constraint; none added.)

unverified.description: Claims not established, each with the exact evidence that is missing. 'Not located' is different from 'did not exist' (source rule 3).

title: CP8-AGENT-RETURN-v1
